title: 2633 Kensington Avenue - 3F
meta: Unit 3F · 3 bed · 2 bath · ~1,400 sq ft · Kensington
description: Bright, spacious 3-bedroom, 2-bath unit offering approximately 1,400 sq ft with abundant windows and hardwood flooring throughout the main living and sleeping areas. The home features recessed lighting and a ceiling fan, plus wall-mounted mini-split AC for personalized climate control. Bedrooms include built-in open-wardrobe organizers for streamlined storage. The bathroom showcases floor tile, subway-tile walls, decorative mosaic trim and a glass-enclosed corner shower with a vanity. A granite-look counter and tiled dining nook add durable surfaces and easy upkeep. Schedule a viewing to see this unit in person.
